verdict.rationale: Stripe explicitly documents an agent-focused capability: issuing virtual cards scoped to a single task/session that auto-invalidate after use, combined with granular spending controls (merchant category, country, MID, per-authorization/monthly limits) and real-time authorization webhooks, which together constitute least-privilege scoped credentials for AI agents. This is directly first-party documented for the agentic use case, not just inferred. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the agent-scoped card feature specifically (community evidence predates this feature and doesn't address it), and no detail on revocation latency or audit-trail specifics for agent credentials.
